        "# ==============================\n",
        "# CUSTOMER SALES ANALYSIS PROJECT\n",
        "# ==============================\n",
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Loading datasets...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "sales = pd.read_csv(\"sales_data (3).csv\")\n",
        "churn = pd.read_csv(\"customer_churn.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Preview datasets\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nSales Data\")\n",
        "print(sales.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nChurn Data\")\n",
        "print(churn.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Data Cleaning\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "sales.dropna(inplace=True)\n",
        "churn.dropna(inplace=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Merge datasets\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "data = pd.merge(sales, churn, left_on=\"Customer_ID\", right_on=\"CustomerID\", how=\"left\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nMerged Data Shape:\", data.shape)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Aggregation 1 - Total Revenue\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "total_revenue = data[\"Total_Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Aggregation 2 - Sales by Region\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "region_sales = data.groupby(\"Region\")[\"Total_Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Aggregation 3 - Product Sales\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "product_sales = data.groupby(\"Product\")[\"Total_Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Average Order Value\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "avg_order = data[\"Total_Sales\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Top Customers\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "top_customers = data.groupby(\"Customer_ID\")[\"Total_Sales\"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Pivot Table\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "pivot = pd.pivot_table(\n",
        "    data,\n",
        "    values=\"Total_Sales\",\n",
        "    index=\"Region\",\n",
        "    columns=\"Product\",\n",
        "    aggfunc=\"sum\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Churn Analysis\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "churn_analysis = churn[\"Churn\"].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Print Results\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n========== CUSTOMER SALES ANALYSIS REPORT ==========\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTotal Revenue:\", total_revenue)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nAverage Order Value:\", avg_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nSales by Region:\")\n",
        "print(region_sales)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTop Customers:\")\n",
        "print(top_customers)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nProduct Sales:\")\n",
        "print(product_sales)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nPivot Table:\")\n",
        "print(pivot)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCustomer Churn Distribution:\")\n",
        "print(churn_analysis)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "# Visualizations\n",
        "# ------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure()\n",
        "region_sales.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sales by Region\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Revenue\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure()\n",
        "product_sales.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Product Sales\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel=\"Revenue\"\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure()\n",
        "product_sales.plot(kind=\"pie\", autopct=\"%1.1f%%\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Product Sales Distribution\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure()\n",
        "sns.heatmap(pivot, annot=True, fmt=\".0f\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sales Heatmap\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure()\n",
        "churn_analysis.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Customer Churn\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nAnalysis Completed Successfully\")"
      ]
    }
  ]
